title: Dark Mode Toggle

input.rawIdea: Add a dark mode toggle. Users switch between light and dark from anywhere. The choice persists across refresh and browser restart. Use the operating system preference only when nothing is saved. A saved light theme overrides a dark system preference. No first-render flicker or hydration mismatch. Keep WCAG contrast and keyboard access. Apply the theme to forms, charts, dialogs, and navigation.

forbiddenOutcomes: custom theme builder is in scope
negativeCases: Saved light theme is replaced by a dark operating-system change.
